Sri Lanka Transport Board Act, No. 27 of 2005
5

(1)
In the exercise, discharge and performance of its

column1: powers, functions and duties, the Board shall be subject to,
and act in accordance with, such general or special directions
as the Minister may from time to time issue in relation to any
matter that appears to him to affect the national interest or
efficient administration of the Board.

column2: (2) The Minister may, from time to time, order all or any

column1: of the activities of the Board to be investigated and reported
upon by such person or persons as he may specify and, upon
such  order  being  made,  the  Board  shall  afford  all  such
facilities,  and  furnish  all  such  information,  as  may  be
necessary to carry out the order.

column2: (3) The  Minister  shall,  in  issuing  directions  under

column1: subsection (1) with regard to any matter affecting the functions
assigned to any other Minister, act in consultation with that
Minister.

column2: (1) The Board may delegate to any member of the

column1: Board or to any employee of the Board any of its powers or
duties other than those specified in paragraphs (a) and (b) of
subsection (1) of section 10 and paragraphs (b), (j), (k) and (l)
of subsection (1) of section 11.

column2: (2) Every person to whom any power or duty has been

column1: delegated under subsection (1) shall exercise or perform the
power or duty so delegated to him subject to the general or
special directions of the Board.

column2: (1) There shall be established an Advisory Committee

column1: for the purpose of this Act.
